requirements: R1: Assign rootCausePatternId to uncategorized task status mismatch defect events to address the statistically confirmed review concern pattern

slices.title: Patch defect events with rootCausePatternId
slices.jtbd: When implementing the root cause assignment for this epic, I want to patch the defect categorization logic, so that uncategorized mismatch events receive a rootCausePatternId without requiring new data models
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a defect event for a task status mismatch
When the system evaluates the review concerns
Then it must assign a rootCausePatternId to the event
And tests must assert the mapping of this invariant pattern
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the rate of uncategorized status mismatch defect events from 100% to 0%
